overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, the RAG correctly detects the sole biased reasoning segment with no segment-level false alarms.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: The strict scorecard records zero true positives because the primary label is not invented here bias rather than Endowment; the finding is correctly located and mechanistically accurate but remains a strict label error.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: The mechanism-first scorecard records a true positive at high_and_moderate and all_identified_confidence_levels because the finding fully captures the hidden mechanism and evidence.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: The overconfidence candidate is a useful abstention because it is explicitly caveated, but it is not sufficiently supported and adds a false positive at the candidate-inclusive threshold.
main_failure_modes: Primary label is a near-neighbor construct instead of the hidden Endowment label.
The candidate relies partly on hindsight and lacks a calibration baseline.
main_strengths: Correct localization to the decision-point-two comparison.
Full capture of the ownership-driven asymmetric evidentiary mechanism.
Accurate abstention language for the candidate finding.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run demonstrates strong mechanism-level detection but weak taxonomy-sensitive performance. Including moderate confidence is necessary to detect the instance, while adding candidates reduces instance-level precision without changing segment-level detection.
